segments.t: 清晨的阳光温暖着波特兰菩提树街的人行道。走出菩提树庭院敞开的大门后，汉娜双手平端着黄铜袖珍指南针，亚瑟和凯勒布则仔细端详着第一张线索卡。请先完整听一遍这一幕。
What a glorious Saturday morning for a treasure walk down Linden Street!
Let us check the brass compass first: east runs straight toward the corner bakery.
Read Clue Card One aloud, Hannah, so we do not miss a single word.
Card One says: Twenty paces east where cool clear water greets the morning birds.
Easy! That is the little carved stone fountain at the end of our block!
Wait, Arthur — whose paces are we counting, yours or mine?
Good question, because Arthur walks like he is chasing a departing bus!
Very funny, Hannah; let us walk side by side at a polite normal step.
Five, ten, fifteen... eighteen, nineteen, and twenty paces right to the curb!
Look ahead — two sparrows are splashing on the rim of the stone fountain!
Thirty years later, the morning birds are still keeping their appointment!
Now look closely at Card One to see what symbol we need to find.
现在我们逐句回顾这段线索寻宝的开场对话。
What a glorious Saturday morning for a treasure walk down Linden Street!
“多么明媚美好的星期六早晨呀，正适合沿菩提树街来一场寻宝漫步！”句首由 What a 引导的感叹句，搭配形容词 glorious（“灿烂的，美好的”），一下子点出了大家出发时的兴奋心情：
What a glorious Saturday morning
而两个名词连在一起则组成了：
for a treasure walk
Let us check the brass compass first: east runs straight toward the corner bakery.
“我们先看看黄铜指南针：正东方向一直通向街角的面包房。”在英语里，表示方向或道路笔直通向某个地方，常用动词 run：
east runs straight toward
并以这个地标作为参照点：
the corner bakery
Read Clue Card One aloud, Hannah, so we do not miss a single word.
“汉娜，大声念出第一张线索卡吧，这样我们一个字也不会漏掉。”在 so 后面表达目的时，英语直接用一般现在时即可：
so we do not miss
句末还用这个词组进一步加强语气：
a single word
Card One says: Twenty paces east where cool clear water greets the morning birds.
“第一张卡上写着：‘向东走二十步，清凉澄澈的泉水在那里迎接清晨的小鸟。’”这句诗意的拟人描写围绕动词 greet（“迎接，向……致意”）展开：
cool clear water greets
迎接那些长着翅膀的小访客：
the morning birds
Easy! That is the little carved stone fountain at the end of our block!
“太简单了！那就是我们这个街区尽头那座雕刻精致的小石喷泉嘛！”在美式英语中，block 指两条街口之间的“街区”：
at the end of our block
Wait, Arthur — whose paces are we counting, yours or mine?
“等等，亚瑟——我们数的是谁的步子，你的还是我的？”疑问所有格代词 whose（“谁的”）直接放在名词前面，不需要加冠词：
whose paces are we counting
后面紧接着两个名词性物主代词：
yours or mine
Good question, because Arthur walks like he is chasing a departing bus!
“问得好，因为亚瑟走起路来简直像在追一辆即将发车的公交车！”在日常口语中，like 放在完整句子前面时常用来替代 as if（“好像，仿佛”）：
walks like he is chasing
形容那辆正准备驶离的车辆：
a departing bus
Very funny, Hannah; let us walk side by side at a polite normal step.
“汉娜你真幽默；我们还是并排按正常、斯文的步速走吧。”注意这个不带冠词的副词短语：
walk side by side
后面用介词 at 引出走路的节奏：
at a polite normal step
Five, ten, fifteen... eighteen, nineteen, and twenty paces right to the curb!
“五、十、十五……十八、十九、二十步，正好到路缘石边！”人行道边缘的石条在美式英语中拼作 curb（英式英语拼作 kerb）：
right to the curb
Look ahead — two sparrows are splashing on the rim of the stone fountain!
“看前面——两只麻雀正在石喷泉的边缘扑腾戏水呢！”副词 ahead 引导视线望向前方：
Look ahead
那里有小鸟正在水边玩耍：
two sparrows are splashing
Thirty years later, the morning birds are still keeping their appointment!
“三十年过去了，清晨的小鸟依然按时赴约！”固定搭配 keep an appointment 意为“守约，按时赴约”：
still keeping their appointment
Now look closely at Card One to see what symbol we need to find.
“现在仔细看看第一张卡片，看看我们需要找到什么标志。”look 与副词 closely 连用，表示“仔细看，凑近端详”：
Now look closely at Card One
后面接上间接疑问句：
what symbol we need to find
让我们用自然的语速再完整听一遍这一幕。
What a glorious Saturday morning for a treasure walk down Linden Street!
Let us check the brass compass first: east runs straight toward the corner bakery.
Read Clue Card One aloud, Hannah, so we do not miss a single word.
Card One says: Twenty paces east where cool clear water greets the morning birds.
Easy! That is the little carved stone fountain at the end of our block!
Wait, Arthur — whose paces are we counting, yours or mine?
Good question, because Arthur walks like he is chasing a departing bus!
Very funny, Hannah; let us walk side by side at a polite normal step.
Five, ten, fifteen... eighteen, nineteen, and twenty paces right to the curb!
Look ahead — two sparrows are splashing on the rim of the stone fountain!
Thirty years later, the morning birds are still keeping their appointment!
Now look closely at Card One to see what symbol we need to find.
向东稳稳迈出二十步，汉娜、亚瑟和凯勒布直接来到了菩提树街上阳光照耀的小石喷泉旁。我们下一幕见。
See you next time!
